3. In the instant case, the proceedings were initiated through charge sheet under the signature of writ-respondent No. 6 on 20-4-2006 and the inquiry officer sent his report on 9-8-2006, that is, after expiry of 3(three) months though he was supposed to send the report within 2 (two) months as specified in rule 143(3) of the Rules, 1982. But writ-respondent No.6 passed the impugned order on 30-11-2006, after 7(seven) months of the framing of charge, that is, much beyond 3(three) months in violation of the proviso to rule 143(4) of the Rules,1982. The proceedings initiated in the present case died its natural death after the expiry of three months as per the above provision of law. As the action of the respondents is ex-facie illegal, the writ-petitioner through his learned Advocate served a notice upon the writ-respondents demanding justice by cancelling the impugned action, but the respondents did not comply with the notice. 

 8. Mr Md Abdun Nur learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing on behalf of the appellants, submits that the time frame as mentioned in Rule 143 of Bangladesh Water Development Board (Employees) Service Rules,1982 is directory and not that of mandatory because there is no provision in the Bangladesh Water Development Board (Employees) Service Rules,1982 that the proceedings drawn up would be treated as invalid or unlawful if the proceedings cannot be completed within the time schedule mentioned in it. 

 13. The High Court Division has come to a finding that Sub-rule (3) of Rule 143 of the Rules warrants that the inquiry officer shall submit a report by such date within two months from the date of his appointment as may be specified in this behalf. The High Court Division has held that it is true that the consequence of non-compliance has not been specified, but the word "shall" rather than "may" has been used implying that the framers of the rule meant the same to be mandatory. proviso to Sub-rule (4) of Rule 143 lays down three months deadline during which the proceeding "shall" be completed and that again, the word used is "shall". Therefore, the High Court Division came to the conclusion that the time frame stipulated in the proviso to Sub-rule (4) of Rule 143 is mandatory. 

 14. In order to resolve the issue, Sub-rule (3) of Rule 143 of Bangladesh Water Development Board (Employees) Service Rules, 1982 should be looked into. The same is quoted as under: 

 15. The proviso to Sub-rule (4) of Rule 143 is also quoted below: 

 16. Having gone through Sub-rule (3) of Rule 143, it appears that the officer appointed to conduct the inquiry shall submit a report after giving the employee a personal hearing, if so desired by him, within two months from the date of his appointment. The enquiry officer could not complete the enquiry within two months. 

 17. The proviso to sub-rule (4) of Rule 143 provides that the proceeding under this rule shall be completed within three months from the date of framing charge against an employee. Emphasis has been given by using the word "shall" in order to complete the proceeding within three months of framing of the charge against an employee. In the case in hand, the proceeding could not be completed within three months as stipulated in the proviso to sub-rule (3) of Rule 143. It is to be seen whether it is mandatory to complete the proceeding within three months. 

 25. In the provision to sub-rule (4) of rule 143, it has been provided that the inquiry officer shall submit a report by such date within two months from the date of his appointment as may be specified in this behalf. Is the provision mandatory? There is no consequence for not concluding the inquiry within two months from the date of appointment of the inquiry officer and, as such, the word "shall" has been used implying that the framer of the rule meant the same to be directory. 

 26. Again the proviso to sub-rule (4) of rule 143 provides that the proceeding shall be completed within three months and no consequence is not provided for not completing the proceeding within three months. Therefore, the time frame given in the proviso is also directory.
